name: gamenet_find_player_row_by_key
description: GameNet::FindPlayerRowByKey walks the player-row list and returns the row with the requested player key, or null when absent.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses native list fixtures.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x432830 validates traversal from g_GameNetPlayerRowHead, key compare at row offset 0, next pointer at offset 0x30c, matching-row return, and null return when missing.
The native GameNet smoke verifies a successful lookup and a missing-key null result.
